the quality assurance of products can be integrated into concurrent product realisation projects based on track and loops principle and three strategies, parallelness, standardization and integration, which is illustrated by an example of a car component project in the automotive industry.

the integration of quality standards in concurrent realisation of product projects in the automotive industry can increase the quality of components and thus increase customer and supplier satisfaction.

the integration of quality standards of the automotive industry in the concurrent realisation processes, and it shows that it is necessary to define quality standards for the concurrent product realisations in the automotive industry in order to increase the quality of concurrent products.

the concurrent product realization can significantly shorten the time to market and reduce the costs of the product realization, while increasing its quality.
